# PhotoCraft
> Free, open-source, in-browser Photoshop alternative built from scratch in pure Rust. Runs in modern browsers via WebGPU/WebAssembly and on native desktop.

## Summary
PhotoCraft is a professional raster graphics editor designed by the ArtCraft project as a clean-room reimplementation of Adobe Photoshop. It provides 1:1 workflow and shortcut parity (Cmd/Ctrl+J, Cmd/Ctrl+T, V for Move, B for Brush), full multi-layer PSD/PSB file fidelity, 52 native tools, 16 adjustment layers, and real ICC color management. It is 100% free under permissive MIT / Apache-2.0 licenses, requires no subscription or account login, and processes all documents locally in browser memory via WebGPU.

## Quick Facts
- **Primary Website**: https://photocraft.work/
- **Full LLM Reference**: https://photocraft.work/llms-full.txt
- **GitHub Repository**: https://github.com/bshx2024/photocraft
- **License**: MIT / Apache-2.0 (100% Free & Open Source)
- **Cost**: $0 (No subscription, No paywalls, No ads, No account needed)
- **Tech Stack**: Pure Rust, WebGPU, WebAssembly (wasm32), wgpu compositor, egui/eframe.

## Core Capabilities
- **1:1 Photoshop Muscle Memory**: Identical UI taxonomy, menu bars, layer effects (Drop Shadow, Stroke, Glow, Bevel), and standard shortcuts.
- **PSD & PSB Round-Trip Fidelity**: Pixel-accurate PSD/PSB opening, editing, and saving without flattening. Verified against 300+ real-world Photoshop oracle files.
- **WebGPU In-Browser Acceleration**: True client-side GPU compositing in modern browsers without plugins or installation.
- **Zero Subscription & 100% Private**: Runs entirely in local WebAssembly memory. Zero bytes of image data are uploaded to any server.
- **Agent-Ready Architecture**: Built for AI automation with 500+ commands accessible via Model Context Protocol (MCP), CLI (`photocraft-cli`), and JSON control socket.
- **Formats Supported**: PSD, PSB, layered TIFF, Paint.NET (PDN), SVG, PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF, OpenEXR, HDR, and native `.pcraft`.

## How to Open & Edit PSD Files Online
1. **Navigate**: Open https://photocraft.work/ in Chrome, Edge, Safari 18+, or Firefox.
2. **Open File**: Drag and drop any `.psd`, `.psb`, or image file directly into the browser canvas, or click "Launch Free Online".
3. **Edit Layers**: Edit using standard Photoshop shortcuts (`V` for Move, `B` for Brush, `Cmd/Ctrl+J` to duplicate layers, `Cmd/Ctrl+T` to Free Transform).
4. **Export**: Export multi-layer PSD files or optimized web formats (PNG, WebP, JPEG) with zero watermarks.

## Key Comparison Matrix

| Feature / Metric | PhotoCraft | Adobe Photoshop | Photopea | GIMP |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Pricing** | **100% Free Open-Source** | $239.88+/year subscription | Ad-supported ($5/mo for ad-free) | Free Open-Source |
| **Account Required** | **None (Instant Access)** | Adobe ID & CC Login | Optional | None |
| **Photoshop Shortcuts** | **1:1 Native Parity** | Native Standard | Good parity | Custom non-standard |
| **PSD File Fidelity** | **Pixel-Accurate (300+ tests)**| Native Standard | Good layer support | Often breaks styles |
| **Runtime & Performance**| **WebGPU (Rust WASM) + Desktop**| Native Desktop (C++) | Web Canvas 2D (JavaScript) | Native Desktop (C) |
| **Data Privacy** | **100% Local / Zero Uploads** | Cloud Sync & Telemetry | Ad trackers & server scripts | 100% Local |
| **AI Agent Support** | **Native MCP Server Protocol** | Closed Plugin API | Not supported | Script-fu only |

## AI Agent & Automation Usage
PhotoCraft is designed for AI coding agents (Claude, Cursor, Windsurf, Antigravity):
- Run headless CLI: `photocraft-cli batch --input design.psd --script resize.json`
- Model Context Protocol: `photocraft-cli mcp` allows LLMs to inspect layer trees, hide/show layers, apply adjustments, and export slices automatically.
